tasks.label: Quality: Run all checks
tasks.command: .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m ruff check .; .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m ruff format --check .; .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pyright; .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest; .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m bandit -r src; .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip_audit
